Name: Silver Fox Rasmodious
Author: FreakyBiscuit1
Description:
A Vanilla friendly take on our cowboy Wizard! Fully compatible with both [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE)[/url] and/or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16893]Romancable Rasmodius Revamped Redux (RRRR)[/url]. Adds portraits, sprites, the new Arcane Hat, and a matching spouse painting for the Traveling Cart!

[b]NOTE: [/b]If using RRRR, be sure to change the config options for Appearance[b]. [/b][b]Portrait Mode [/b]needs to be set to [b]"Full Portraits (32)", [/b]and [b]Sprites [/b]set to[b] "Use Custom". [/b]You do not need to change anything if only using SVE!

[line]
